Triage: lands in `domain:engine` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`); rationale: class (b), with the contract quoted from the helper's **own docblock** — *"The two sites that report a blocked unique … must name the SAME rows in the SAME shape, and a second hand-rolled `.slice(0, 5).join('; ')` is exactly how the plain and the NULL-safe path drifted apart in the first place."* The fourth site is that exact hand-rolled shape, and ⭐ **the drift it predicts has already happened**: helper emits `; ...and N more group(s)`, hand-rolled emits `; ...and N more`. Two durability logs about the same failure class, from the same `catch`, already disagreeing. `Bug`.

⭐ Worth naming because it is the rarer kind of finding: this is not "a helper exists and someone did not use it" — it is a helper written **specifically to prevent this drift**, whose docblock names this exact code shape as the cause of the previous occurrence, and the drift recurred anyway on the one arm that was left behind. The rule was written down at the site and still did not carry.

`priority:p3`: the divergence is only visible past **five** conflicting groups in one table, which is why nothing has tripped over it, and it is log text — ⛔ no data effect, no behaviour change. Cheap and bounded.

Route notes, both from the card and both load-bearing:

1. ⚠️ **Read the existing pin before editing.** `sql-driver-12998-shadow-null-safe-key.test.ts` asserts on this message; the card's reading is that it asserts the `Conflicting group(s):` **prefix** and not the overflow tail. That determines whether this change is text-visible to any test at all — and if it is not, the PR should say so rather than leaving the impression a green suite verified the new text. ⛔ Do not infer coverage from the suite passing.
2. ⚠️ **This needs the live MySQL cell re-run**, which is why #16288 correctly left it out of its bounded-fix budget rather than folding in a one-line change. ⭐ Cross-reference for whoever runs it: **#16434** (graded `p2` today) records that `packages/drivers/driver-sql` is the one live-DB driver in the repo with **no `testTimeout`**, so its live cells run under vitest's default 5000ms — a live re-run here can red on that budget rather than on this diff. ⛔ If it does, that is #16434, not a regression from this change.

Keep the surrounding `Conflicting group(s): ...` framing byte-identical to the other three sites — the point of the change is that all four render the same way, so ⛔ this must not become an opportunity to improve the wording at one site.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.
